general.summary: Attackers are exploiting CVE-2026-115731, a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Perforce Puppet Enterprise, an enterprise solution used by IT teams to centralize and automatize endpoint management. Details about the in-the-wild attacks have yet to be made public, but the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Tuesday and ordered US federal civilian agencies to address it by December 1, 2026. general.summary: Oracleは11月17日（現地時間）、Java SE向けのセキュリティ更新を公開し、11件の脆弱性を修正した。これらには、認証なしでリモートから任意のコードを実行される可能性がある「Java4Shell」（CVE-2026-114938）が含まれる。特定のCPUとJava実行環境を組み合わせた場合に影響を受けるほか、Javaを利用する業務アプリケーションにも影響が及ぶ可能性がある。
general.title: Oracle Javaに11件の脆弱性、「Java4Shell」は認証不要でコード実行の恐れ

general.summary: On 18 November 2026, F5 published an advisory addressing five vulnerabilities in NGINX that allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute code with the privileges of the NGINX worker process. While researchers managed to successfully demonstrate the use of CVE-2026-123007, no exploitation in the wild has been reported yet. It is recommended to swiftly update NGINX as soon as possible, prioritising internet facing appliances.
general.title: 2026-022: Critical vulnerabilities in Nginx
